Definition: from G4314 and G4078; to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross):--crucify.
BiblicalUsage: Prospegnumi means to fasten to, to impale, to crucify. It appears once, in Peter's sermon at Pentecost: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter names both truths in one breath: men did it with wicked hands, and God had determined it before the world began.
